title: Differentiable Logic Cellular Automata: From Game of Life to Pattern Generation
notes: Learns fully discrete CA rules through differentiable logic circuits.

title: Growing Neural Cellular Automata
notes: Introduces end-to-end differentiable self-organizing CA that grow and regenerate target patterns.

title: CAX: Cellular Automata Accelerated in JAX
notes: Provides fast infrastructure for large sweeps over CA rule families and dimensions.

title: muNCA: Texture Generation with Ultra-Compact Neural Cellular Automata
notes: Shows surprisingly expressive CA rules can be represented with only tens to hundreds of parameters.
